verdict: Group Policy forbids this installation. Most commonly AppLocker or a Software Restriction Policy is blocking msiexec or the publisher certificate.
fix: From the client, run `gpresult /h c:\windows\temp\gpo.html` and search for AppLocker / SRP rules matching the installer publisher or path. Exclude MECM content paths (`%windir%\ccmcache\*`, `C:\Windows\Temp\*`) from AppLocker policies, or add a publisher-based Allow rule for the vendor's signing certificate. For service-account installs check the applied policy set (`gpresult /scope:computer`).
